reason: WaitPerk is a Claude Code status-line monetization tool that displays sponsor messages, not a Claude usage tracker—it measures impression time and earnings rather than tokens, cost, or API usage metrics.

nord-kit is a Claude Code plugin marketplace with multi-agent skills and utilities, not a usage tracker; it provides a statusline (nord-hud) that displays context/model info but does not measure or report Claude usage (tokens, cost, quotas) as a feature.

Lararium is a delightful companion/pet simulator for Claude Code that lives in the statusline, but it does not display, measure, or report Claude usage (tokens, cost, quotas, sessions) — instead it reflects coding mood and progress, making it a companion tool rather than a usage tracker.

This is a notification and status UI plugin for Claude Code that displays agent session state (waiting/complete) but does not measure, display, or report Claude usage metrics like tokens, cost, or rate limits.
This is a UI/rendering bundle for the Pi coding agent with Claude Code-inspired styling and components; it does not measure, display, or report Claude usage metrics, tokens, costs, or quotas.

This project installs statusline configurations for multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok) but does not itself track, measure, or report Claude usage—it merely displays pre-existing usage metrics from those agents' native statuslines.

DevDeck manages Claude Code and Grok sessions (resume, kill, organize) but does not display, measure, or report usage metrics like tokens, cost, or quotas — it is a session manager, not a usage tracker.

This is a Claude Code hook that snapshots work to prevent loss during context limits, but does not display, measure, or report Claude usage metrics—it addresses work preservation rather than usage tracking.
